packets.title: S008 Al-Anfal CP01 vv001-019
paragraphs: Translations: Arabic primary. Core five on split loci.
Medinan. First battle-and-spoils surah in canonical order. 7:157 cluster remains parked as a problem file; this packet does not reopen it.

They ask you about the anfāl. Say: the anfāl belong to God and the Messenger. So fear God, set right what is between you, and obey God and His Messenger if you are believers. Believers: when God is mentioned their hearts tremble; when His signs are recited it increases them in faith; they trust their Lord; they establish the prayer and spend from what We provided. Those are the true believers. For them degrees with their Lord, and forgiveness, and a generous provision.

As your Lord brought you out from your house by the truth, and a party of the believers were unwilling — they disputed with you about the truth after it was made clear, as if they were being driven to death while they looked on. When God promised you one of the two parties, that it would be yours, and you wished the unarmed one were yours. God wanted to establish the truth by His words and cut off the last of the unbelievers, to establish truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

When you sought help of your Lord and He answered: I will reinforce you with a thousand angels, following one another. God made it only as good news and so that your hearts would be at rest. Help is only from God. God is Mighty, Wise. When He covered you with drowsiness as security from Him, and sent down on you water from the sky to purify you by it, remove from you Satan’s filth, strengthen your hearts, and plant your feet. When your Lord revealed to the angels: I am with you, so make firm those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved. So strike above the necks and strike from them every fingertip.

That is because they opposed God and His Messenger. Whoever opposes God and His Messenger — God is severe in penalty. That is for you: taste it. For the unbelievers the punishment of the Fire. O you who believe, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing, do not turn your backs to them. Whoever turns his back that day, unless turning aside for battle or joining a company, has incurred anger from God. His refuge is Hell. Wretched destination.

You did not kill them, but God killed them. You did not throw when you threw, but God threw — that He might test the believers with a good test from Him. God is Hearing, Knowing. That, and God weakens the plot of the unbelievers. If you seek the decision, the decision has come to you. If you desist it is better for you. If you return We return. Your company will not avail you at all even if it is many. God is with the believers.

1–4: spoils belong to God and the Messenger; portrait of real believers. 5–8: going out from the house; party unwilling; two caravans; truth to be established. 9–14: help of a thousand angels; drowsiness and rain; strike necks and fingertips. 15–16: no turning the back. 17–19: you did not throw; the decision has come.

They ask about al-anfāl. The decision is God’s and the Messenger’s. Fear, set right what is between you, obey. The word is the surah-title. Division of spoils is postponed in detail until 8:41 (next packets). Level 1 here: the anfāl are not the fighters’ raw claim.

Brought out from the house by the truth. A party unwilling, as if driven to death. Promise of one of two parties (one armed, one unarmed). They wanted the unarmed. God wanted to establish the truth by His words and cut off the last of the unbelievers. Traditional referent is Badr (caravan / relief force). The verse does not name Badr. Park the battle-name as tafsīr-label; the two-parties structure is Level 1.

A thousand angels in succession. Help is only from God; the angels are good news and heart-rest. Drowsiness as security; water to purify, remove Satan’s rijz, firm the feet. To the angels: I am with you; cast terror; strike above the necks and every banān (finger-tip / extremity).
When you meet the unbelievers advancing, do not turn your backs. Exception: tactical turning, or joining a company. Otherwise: anger, Hell. First walked battlefield-flight rule.

You did not kill them; God killed them. You did not throw when you threw; God threw. Purpose-clause: a good test / fair benefit for the believers. The throw is second-person singular (the addressee). What was thrown is not named. Sand-in-the-eyes is tafsīr.
anfāl. ḥaqq. iḥdā l-ṭāʾifatayn. alfi mina l-malāʾika. nuʿās. rijz al-shayṭān. ḍarb fawqa l-aʿnāq / banān. wallā l-dubur. mā ramayta idh ramayta.
SI: the bounties [of war]. Haleem: distribution of battle gains. Pickthall: the spoils of war. Arberry: the spoils.
anfal = extra / spoils. SI's 'bounties' is soft. Haleem names distribution. The ask is about the things taken.
SI: upon the necks; every fingertip. Haleem: above the necks; every finger. Pickthall: above the necks; every finger-end. Arberry: above the necks; every finger.
SI: you threw not when you threw. Haleem: it was not you who threw. Pickthall: thou threwest not when thou didst throw. Arberry: when thou threwest, it was not thyself that threw.
Same spine. Haleem drops the 'when you threw' echo slightly. The paradox is the point.
SI: a good test. Haleem: a good test. Pickthall: a fair test. Arberry: a fair benefit.
bala' = test / trial; also benefit. Arberry hears the second.

SI: seek the victory / the defeat has come. Haleem: asked for judgement / judgement has come. Pickthall: ask for a decision / the decision has come. Arberry: asked for the opening / the opening has come upon you.
f-t-h: opening / decision / victory. Pickthall/Haleem keep 'decision.' SI jumps to victory/defeat.
Yusuf Ali 8:17 line only: 'when thou threwest (a handful of dust).' The handful is his gloss.

Spoils are not raw fighter-right. Going out can be against a party’s will. Help is God’s even when angels are named. Flight from a meeting has a Hell-clause with two tactical exceptions. Agency: they kill and throw, and they did not — God did. That is this panel’s theology of the fight, not a denial that bodies fell.
8:41 fifth of spoils — next. 3:123–125 Badr angels already walked (3,000 / 5,000). 9:25–26 Ḥunayn parked. 8:67–69 captives parked in this surah.

No Torah/Gospel battle of Badr. Functional cousins: YHWH as warrior (Exod 15; Josh 10:11 stones from heaven); ‘not by your sword’ (Josh 24:12; Ps 44:3). Herem / spoils rules (Deut 20; Num 31) are a later packet when 8:41 and 8:67 are walked. Do not dump them here.
QB-0231 POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP of divine warrior: the human blow is real and not the last cause. CONTRAST of setting (Badr vs Canaan/Egypt). No named biblical twin for 8:17’s throw.
Medinan, post-Badr by consensus of the tradition; the text itself does not date the year. QRQ-0004 messenger’s disposal of anfāl. QRQ-0001 help is God’s.
Anfal belong to God and the Messenger; set right what is between you
Brought out unwilling; two parties; truth to be established
Thousand angels; rain; strike necks and fingertips
Do not turn the back except tactic or joining a company
You did not kill / you did not throw when you threw
Divine warrior cousin; no Badr twin
Muhammad: asked about spoils; thrown (singular); help-seeker. God: owns anfāl; answers with angels; kills and throws. Level 1: Badr unnamed; thrown object unnamed.
The first nineteen verses take the spoils off the fighters’ table, put the unwilling on the road, and then say the blow they struck was God’s.
8:20–40 — obey; trail of Satan; the worst beasts; spend.

packets.title: S008 Al-Anfal CP02 vv020-040
paragraphs: Translations: Arabic primary. Core five on split loci.

O you who believe, obey God and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear. Do not be like those who said we hear and they do not hear. The worst of beasts with God are the deaf and dumb who do not understand. Had God known any good in them He would have made them hear. If He made them hear they would turn away, refusing.

O you who believe, respond to God and to the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life. Know that God comes between a man and his heart, and that you will be gathered to Him. Beware of a fitna that will not strike those who did wrong among you exclusively. Know that God is severe in penalty. Remember when you were few, oppressed in the land, fearing that the people would snatch you. He gave you refuge, supported you with His help, and provided you of the good things, that you might be thankful.

O you who believe, do not betray God and the Messenger, and do not betray your trusts while you know. Know that your wealth and your children are a fitna, and that with God is a great wage. O you who believe, if you fear God He will make for you a furqān, wipe from you your evils, and forgive you. God is the possessor of great bounty.

When the unbelievers plotted against you to restrain you, or kill you, or expel you. They plot and God plots. God is the best of plotters. When Our signs are recited they say: we have heard; if we wished we would say the like of this; this is only tales of the ancients. When they said: God, if this is the truth from You, rain on us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment. God would not punish them while you are among them. God would not punish them while they seek forgiveness. What have they that God should not punish them, when they bar from the Sacred Mosque and they are not its friends? Its friends are only the God-fearing, but most of them do not know. Their prayer at the House is only whistling and clapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved.

Those who disbelieve spend their wealth to bar from the path of God. They will spend it, then it will be a regret for them, then they will be overcome. Those who disbelieve will be gathered to Hell — that God may distinguish the vile from the good, and place the vile some of it on others, heap it all, and put it in Hell. Those are the losers.

Say to those who disbelieve: if they desist, what has gone before will be forgiven them. If they return, the pattern of the ancients has already passed. Fight them until there is no fitna and the religion is all God’s. If they desist, God sees what they do. If they turn away, know that God is your protector. Excellent protector, excellent helper.

20–23 hear/obey; worst beasts. 24–26 respond; God between a man and his heart; fitna not only for the wrongdoers; few-and-snatched remembered. 27–29 no betrayal; wealth and children a fitna; furqān for those who fear. 30–35 plot to restrain/kill/expel; tales of the ancients; stones-from-sky dare; no punishment while you are among them / while they seek forgiveness; bar from the Mosque; prayer as whistling. 36–37 spend to bar; gathered to Hell. 38–40 desist and be forgiven; fight until no fitna and religion is God’s.

Obey God and the Messenger; do not turn from him while you hear. Worst of beasts: deaf, dumb, who do not understand. If He made them hear they would still turn away. Hearing here is not ear-function. It is the hearing that becomes obedience.

Respond to God and the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life. God comes between a man and his heart. A fitna that will not hit only those who did wrong among you — a communal blow. Once few, oppressed, fearing snatch; He gave refuge and help. Do not betray God, the Messenger, or known trusts. Wealth and children are a fitna. If you fear, He makes a furqān, wipes evils, forgives.

They plotted to restrain, kill, or expel you. They plot; God plots; He is the best of plotters. ‘If we wished we would say the like’ — tales of the ancients. Dare: if this is truth, rain stones. He would not punish while you are among them, nor while they seek forgiveness. Then: what excuse, when they bar from the Sacred Mosque and are not its friends? Friends are the God-fearing. Their prayer at the House: mukāʾ and taṣdiya (whistling and clapping).

If they desist, what went before is forgiven. If they return, the sunna of the ancients has passed. Fight them until there is no fitna and the religion is all God’s. If they desist, He sees. If they turn away, God is your mawlā. This is the walked cousin of 2:193. Fitna here sits next to religion-being-God’s. Do not flatten it to ‘persecution only’ or ‘unbelief only’ before more of this surah is walked (8:39 restates 2:193’s pair).

lā tatawallaw ʿanhu. sharra l-dawābb. yaḥūlu bayna l-marʾi wa-qalbihi. fitna. khāʾin. furqān. yamkurū / yamkuru llāh. asāṭīr al-awwalīn. mukāʾ / taṣdiya. ḥattā lā takūna fitna wa-yakūna l-dīnu kulluhu lillāh.
SI: worst of living creatures. Haleem: worst creatures. Pickthall: worst of beasts. Arberry: worst of beasts.
dawabb = beasts / moving creatures. Same insult-shape as 8:55 later.
SI: comes between a man and his heart. Haleem: comes between a man and his heart. Pickthall: cometh in between a man and his own heart. Arberry: stands between a man and his heart.
No split that changes the call. Agency over the heart.
SI: a criterion. Haleem: a way out of every difficulty. Pickthall: a distinction / criterion. Arberry: a deliverance / discrimination.
Same word as the title of S025 and as 2:53 / 3:4. Haleem unpacks as relief. Keep the Arabic.
SI: whistling and clapping of hands. Haleem: whistling and clapping. Pickthall: whistling and handclapping. Arberry: whistling and clapping of hands.
No split. Prayer at the House reduced to noise.
8:39 hatta la takuna fitnatun wa-yakuna l-dinu kulluhu lillah

SI: until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion, all of it, is for Allah. Haleem: until there is no more persecution, and all worship is devoted to God alone. Pickthall: until persecution is no more and religion is all for Allah. Arberry: till there is no persecution and the religion is God's entirely.
fitna: SI keeps the Arabic; Haleem/Pickthall/Arberry = persecution. 2:193 already walked this pair. Do not let one English close the word.
Yusuf Ali 8:39 line only: 'until there is no more tumult or oppression, and there prevail justice and faith in Allah altogether.' Adds justice.

Hearing without obeying is beast-status. God can stand between a man and his heart. Fitna can land on more than the guilty. Wealth and children are named as fitna. A plot to restrain, kill, or expel is answered by God’s own plot. Punishment is withheld while the messenger is among them and while forgiveness is sought — then the Mosque-barring cancels the excuse. Desist: past forgiven. Return: the ancients’ pattern. Fight until fitna is gone and religion is all God’s.
2:193 fight until no fitna and religion is God’s — walked. 2:217 fitna worse than killing — walked. 3:54 they plotted and God plotted. 8:55 worst of beasts again. 9:5 / 9:29 parked.

Ps 2 / nations plot; Gen 50:20 you meant evil, God meant good — plot-cousins, not identity. Herem-until-the-land-is-the-LORD’s (Deut 7; 20) is the nearest ‘until religion is X’ cousin; different law-shape. Do not merge until 8:41 and 9 are walked.

Medinan. QRQ-0004 obey the Messenger when he calls to what gives life. QRQ-0007 fight-until clause restated.

Plot to restrain, kill, or expel; God is best of plotters
No punishment while you are among them / they seek forgiveness; prayer as whistling
Desist: past forgiven. Fight until no fitna and religion is all God's
Fitna in 8:39 still OPEN as English

Muhammad: they plotted to restrain, kill, or expel him; he is the reason punishment is withheld while he is among them. God: stands between man and heart; best of plotters; mawlā. Level 1: House-prayer as noise; no named tribe.
Hear and live. A plot against the messenger. Forgiveness if they stop. If not: fight until fitna is gone and the religion is all God’s.
8:41–58 — the fifth; Badr meeting; treaty-breakers; the worst of beasts who do not keep faith.

packets.title: S008 Al-Anfal CP03 vv041-058
paragraphs: Authority/Sunnah/Hadith cluster stays parked. This packet is spoils-law and the meeting-day.

Know that whatever you take as spoils, a fifth of it is for God and for the Messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans and the needy and the traveler — if you believe in God and in what We sent down on Our servant on the day of furqān, the day the two parties met. God is over all things powerful.

When you were on the near side of the valley and they on the farther side, and the caravan below you. If you had appointed a meeting you would have missed it. But that God might conclude a matter already done — that he who perished might perish upon clear proof, and he who lived might live upon clear proof. God is Hearing, Knowing.

When God showed them to you in your sleep as few. If He had shown them as many you would have failed and disputed in the matter. But God saved. He knows what is in the breasts. When He showed them to you when you met as few in your eyes, and made you few in their eyes, that God might conclude a matter already done. To God affairs are returned.

O you who believe, when you meet a company, be firm and remember God much, that you may prosper. Obey God and His Messenger, do not dispute lest you fail and your wind go. Be patient. God is with the patient. Do not be like those who went out of their homes boastfully to be seen by people, and bar from God’s path. God encompasses what they do.

When Satan made their deeds fair to them and said: no one will overcome you today from among the people, and I am your neighbor. When the two companies came in sight he turned on his heels and said: I am quit of you; I see what you do not see; I fear God; God is severe in penalty. When the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts said: their religion has deluded these. Whoever relies on God — God is Mighty, Wise.

If you could see when the angels take those who disbelieved, striking their faces and their backs: taste the punishment of the burning. That is for what your hands sent ahead. God is not unjust to the servants. Like the custom of Pharaoh’s house and those before them: they disbelieved God’s signs so God seized them for their sins. God is strong, severe in penalty. That is because God would not change a favor He had bestowed on a people until they change what is in themselves. God is Hearing, Knowing. Like the custom of Pharaoh’s house and those before them: they denied the signs of their Lord so We destroyed them for their sins and drowned Pharaoh’s house. All were wrongdoers.

The worst of beasts with God are those who disbelieve, so they will not believe — those with whom you made a compact, then they break their compact every time, and they do not fear. If you meet them in war, make an example of them for those behind them, that they may remember. If you fear treachery from a people, throw back to them on equal terms. God does not love the treacherous.

41 khums + day of furqān + two parties. 42–44 geography of the meeting; dream of few; mutual fewness. 45–47 firmness; no dispute; not the boastful going-out. 48–49 Satan abandons; hypocrites sneer. 50–54 angels strike faces; Pharaoh-pattern; God does not lift a favor until they change themselves. 55–58 worst beasts; compact-breakers; example in war; throw the treaty back if you fear treachery.

Whatever you take as ghanimtum: one-fifth for God, the Messenger, kin, orphans, needy, traveler — if you believe in God and in what was sent down on Our servant on the day of furqān, the day the two parties met. 8:1 said anfāl belong to God and the Messenger. 8:41 now names a fifth and six payees. How the other four-fifths sit is not spelled here. Later fiqh fills that. Level 1: a fifth is assigned; belief is tied to that day.

Near bank, far bank, caravan below. If you had appointed a rendezvous you would have disagreed. God concludes a matter already done, so that perishing and living rest on clear proof. Dream: the enemy shown as few. At the meeting both sides see the other as few. Traditional Badr geography. The verse still does not say the word Badr.

Be firm; remember God much; obey; do not dispute or your rīḥ (wind / force) goes. Not the ones who went out ostentatiously to be seen and bar the path. Satan: no one will beat you; I am neighbor. Then he turns: I am quit; I see what you do not; I fear God. Hypocrites: their religion has deluded them.

Angels take the unbelievers striking faces and backs: taste the burning. Like Āl Firʿawn. God does not change a favor on a people until they change what is in themselves. Drowned Pharaoh’s house. Moses-dossier echo already walked in S007.

Worst of beasts: those who disbelieve, so they will not believe — those you made a compact with, then they break it every time. If you meet them in war, make of them an example (sharrid bihim) for those behind them. If you fear treachery, nabidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāʾ — throw back to them on even terms. God does not love the treacherous. Treaty-law: fear of breach permits public repudiation, not secret betrayal.
ghanimtum / khums. yawm al-furqān. iltaqā l-jamʿān. ʿidwa al-dunyā / al-quṣwā. al-ʿīr. rīḥ. sharrid. nabidh ʿalā sawāʾ. alladhīna ʿāhadta minhum.
SI: obtained of war booty / one fifth. Haleem: take as spoils / one-fifth. Pickthall: whatever ye take as spoils / a fifth. Arberry: whatever booty / a fifth.
ghanima = spoils taken. Fifth is shared.
SI: the Day of Criterion. Haleem: the Day of Distinction. Pickthall: the Day of Discrimination. Arberry: the day of salvation / discrimination.
Same word as 8:29. Meeting-day is named furqan.
SI: lose courage. Haleem: lose heart. Pickthall: your power depart. Arberry: your wind depart.
rih = wind. Arberry/Pickthall keep the figure. SI/Haleem flatten to morale.

SI: make an example of them for those behind them. Haleem: make a fearsome example of them to those who come after them. Pickthall: make an example of them for those who come after them. Arberry: deal with them so as to scatter those behind them.
sh-r-d: scatter / make an example. Arberry hears scatter.

SI: throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting] on equal terms. Haleem: equally notify them that you repudiated it. Pickthall: throw back their covenant into their teeth fairly. Arberry: cast it back to them equally.
Public, even-handed repudiation. Not a secret knife.
Yusuf Ali 8:41 line only: 'one fifth share is assigned to Allah, and to the Messenger...'

Spoils are not raw grab; a fifth is assigned to God-and-messenger-and-the-weak. The meeting was not their appointment; it was a matter already done. Satan talks neighbor and then quits. Compact-breakers are worst beasts. Treachery feared: throw the compact back in the open. God does not love the treacherous — including, by the grammar, a treacherous response.
8:1 anfāl. 8:29 furqān. 2:193 / 8:39 fitna-until. 7:130–136 Pharaoh drowned. 9:1–12 bara'a parked.

Spoils fifth vs Num 31:28–30 tribute to YHWH/Levites (different fraction and payees). Treaty-repudiation vs Deut 20:10–18 / Josh 9 Gibeon. QB-0243 POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP of sacred cut from spoils. QB-0244 CONTRAST of even-handed nabidh vs herem of certain Canaanite towns. Do not merge.
Fifth of spoils: God, Messenger, kin, orphans, needy, traveler
Day of furqan = day the two parties met; banks and caravan
Shown few in sleep and in the meeting; matter already done
Firm; no dispute or your wind goes; Satan quits
Angels strike faces; Pharaoh-pattern; favor not lifted until they change
Worst beasts break compact; example in war; throw treaty back on even terms
Sacred cut from spoils — cousin of Num 31 tribute
Even nabidh vs herem — do not merge

A fifth is taken off the pile. The two parties met on a day named furqān. Compacts that are broken may be thrown back in the open. Next: 8:59–75 — prepare force; captives; those who believed and emigrated.

packets.title: S008 Al-Anfal CP04 vv059-075
paragraphs: Let not those who disbelieve think they have outstripped. They do not frustrate. Prepare against them whatever you can of force and of horses of war, by which you terrify the enemy of God and your enemy, and others besides them whom you do not know; God knows them. Whatever you spend in God’s path is repaid to you. You will not be wronged.

If they incline to peace, incline to it, and rely on God. He is the Hearing, the Knowing. If they want to deceive you, God is sufficient for you. He is the one who supported you with His help and with the believers, and brought their hearts together. If you had spent all that is in the earth you would not have brought their hearts together, but God brought them together. He is Mighty, Wise. O Prophet, God is sufficient for you and for whoever follows you of the believers.

O Prophet, urge the believers to fight. If there are twenty steadfast among you they will overcome two hundred. If there are a hundred they will overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they are a people who do not understand. Now God has lightened for you; He knew there is weakness in you. So if there are a hundred steadfast they will overcome two hundred. If a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by God’s leave. God is with the steadfast.

It is not for a prophet to have captives until he has caused slaughter in the land. You want the goods of this world, and God wants the last. God is Mighty, Wise. Had a prior writing from God not existed, a great punishment would have touched you for what you took. So eat of what you took as spoils, lawful and good, and fear God. God is Forgiving, Merciful.

O Prophet, say to the captives in your hands: if God knows any good in your hearts He will give you better than what was taken from you, and forgive you. God is Forgiving, Merciful. If they want betrayal of you, they have already betrayed God before, so He gave power over them. God is Knowing, Wise.

Those who believed and emigrated and strove with their property and their lives in God’s path, and those who gave shelter and helped — those are protectors of one another. Those who believed but did not emigrate: you have no walāya of them until they emigrate. If they ask you for help in religion, you must help, except against a people between you and whom is a compact. God sees what you do.

Those who disbelieve are protectors of one another. Unless you do this, there will be fitna in the land and great corruption. Those who believed and emigrated and strove in God’s path, and those who gave shelter and helped — those are the believers in truth. For them forgiveness and a generous provision. Those who believed afterwards and emigrated and strove with you — they are of you. Relatives are nearer to one another in God’s Book. God is of all things Knowing.

59–60 they have not escaped; prepare force and horses. 61–64 incline to peace; God sufficient; hearts joined. 65–66 ratio of fighters, then lightened. 67–69 no captives until slaughter in the land; prior writing averted punishment; eat the spoils. 70–71 word to captives. 72–75 emigrants and helpers as mutual awliyāʾ; no walāya of non-emigrants until they move; help-in-religion except against a compact-people; unbelievers’ mutual protection; kin nearer in the Book.

Prepare what you can of force (quwwa) and tethered horses, to terrify God’s enemy and yours, and others you do not know. If they incline to peace (salm), incline to it and rely. The two sentences sit together: readiness, then incline-if-they-incline. Neither cancels the other at Level 1.

Twenty steadfast overcome two hundred; a hundred, a thousand — because they do not understand. Then lightened: He knew weakness in you. A hundred overcome two hundred; a thousand, two thousand. The first ratio is 1:10. The second is 1:2. The text itself calls the second a lightening.

It is not for a prophet to have captives until he yuthkhina in the land (causes heavy slaughter / thoroughly subdues). You want the goods of this world; God wants the last. Had a prior writing not existed, great punishment for what you took. Then: eat of what you ghanimtum, lawful, good. Traditional tafsīr: Badr captives ransomed too early. Level 1: a prophet-rule about captives before the land is subdued; a prior kitāb averted the blow; the taken goods are then released as lawful.

Belief + hijra + jihād with property and lives, plus those who sheltered and helped: mutual protectors. Believed-but-did-not-emigrate: no walāya until they emigrate. If they ask help in religion, help — except against a people with a compact. Unbelievers are protectors of one another; unless you do ‘this,’ fitna and fasād in the land. Later believers who emigrate and strive: they are of you. Kin are nearer to each other in God’s Book.
quwwa / ribāṭ al-khayl. janaha lil-salm. yuḥarriḍ. yuthkhina fī l-arḍ. kitāb min Allāh sabaqa. asārā. hājarū / āwaw / naṣarū. walāya. ūlū l-arḥām.
SI: power / steeds of war. Haleem: military force / cavalry. Pickthall: force / horses tethered. Arberry: force / horses of war.
Horses named. Force is broader than horses.
SI: incline to peace. Haleem: incline to peace. Pickthall: incline to peace. Arberry: incline to peace.
SI: he has thoroughly subdued [the enemy] in the land. Haleem: he has thinned the enemy's ranks. Pickthall: he hath made slaughter in the land. Arberry: he make wide slaughter in the land.
th-kh-n: thicken / make massive slaughter / subdue hard. SI hears subdue; Pickthall/Arberry hear slaughter.
SI: guardianship. Haleem: protection / alliance. Pickthall: protection / friends. Arberry: friends / protection.
wala' of the hijra-community. Not generic affection.
SI: blood relations. Haleem: blood relatives. Pickthall: kindred by blood. Arberry: those related by blood.
Kin nearer in the Book — inheritance/nearness after the hijra-bond is stated.
Yusuf Ali 8:67 line only: 'until he hath thoroughly subdued the land.'

Readiness and incline-to-peace are both commanded. Fighter-ratios are first severe then lightened because of known weakness. A prophet is not to hold captives before the land is thinned/subdued; wanting ransom is wanting this world’s goods; a prior writing averted punishment; then eat the spoils. Community-bond is hijra-plus-help. Belief without emigration does not yet create walāya. Compact still limits whom you may fight when a non-emigrant asks help. Unbelievers’ mutual protection is named as the alternative that yields fitna.

9:29 parked. 4:92–94 parked already as killing-believer law. Captives vs Deut 20:13–14 (males of certain towns; women and spoil taken) and Num 31. QB-0245 POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP of spoil-after-battle. QB-0246 CONTRAST: 8:67 delays captives until yuthkhin; Deut 20 splits towns by near/far and ḥērem. QB-0247 hijra-walāya has no Torah twin; kinship-nearer-in-the-Book is the closer cousin of clan law.
Prepare force and horses; terrify; spend repaid
If they incline to peace, incline; God sufficient; hearts joined
Not for a prophet to have captives until yuthkhin; prior writing averted punishment
Word to captives; prior betrayal of God
Hijra + shelter = mutual walaya; no walaya of non-emigrants; help-in-religion except vs compact
Unbelievers' mutual protection; else fitna; kin nearer in the Book

S008 complete: spoils belong first to God and the Messenger; the throw was God’s; fight until fitna is gone and religion is all God’s; a fifth is cut; compact-breakers are made an example and treaties are thrown back in the open; prepare force and still incline to peace; captives too early drew a warning; the living bond is hijra-plus-help.
Canonical next: S009 al-Tawba 9:1. Note: S009 has no basmala. Flag that at CP01.

pickthall.name: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ ۖ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.itani: They ask you about the bounties. Say, “The bounties are for God and the Messenger.” So be mindful of God, and settle your differences, and obey God and His Messenger, if you are believers.
verses.pickthall: They ask thee (O Muhammad) of the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the messenger, so keep your duty to Allah, and adjust the matter of your difference, and obey Allah and His messenger, if ye are (true) believers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَٰنًۭا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.itani: The believers are those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, they strengthen them in faith, and upon their Lord they rely.
verses.pickthall: They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited unto them they increase their faith, and who trust in their Lord;

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.itani: Those who perform the prayer; and from Our provisions to them, they spend.
verses.pickthall: Who establish worship and spend of that We have bestowed on them.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّۭا ۚ لَّهُمْ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: These are the true believers. They have high standing with their Lord, and forgiveness, and a generous provision.
verses.pickthall: Those are they who are in truth believers. For them are grades (of honour) with their Lord, and pardon, and a bountiful provision.

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَٰرِهُونَ
verses.itani: Even as your Lord brought you out of your home with the truth, some believers were reluctant.
verses.pickthall: Even as thy Lord caused thee (Muhammad) to go forth from thy home with the Truth, and lo! a party of the believers were averse (to it).

verses.arabic: يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ فِى ٱلْحَقِّ بَعْدَمَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.itani: Arguing with you about the truth after it was made clear, as if they were being driven to death as they looked on.
verses.pickthall: Disputing with thee of the Truth after it had been made manifest, as if they were being driven to death visible.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.itani: God has promised you one of the two groups—that it would be yours—but you wanted the unarmed group to be yours. God intends to prove the truth with His words, and to uproot the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: And when Allah promised you one of the two bands (of the enemy) that it should be yours, and ye longed that other than the armed one might be yours. And Allah willed that He should cause the Truth to triumph by His words, and cut the root of the disbelievers;

verses.arabic: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.itani: In order to confirm the truth and nullify falsehood, even though the guilty dislike it.
verses.pickthall: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
verses.itani: When you appealed to your Lord for help, He answered you, “I am reinforcing you with one thousand angels in succession.”
verses.pickthall: When ye sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels, rank on rank.

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.itani: God only made it a message of hope, and to set your hearts at rest. Victory comes only from God. God is Mighty and Wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah appointed it only as good tidings, and that your hearts thereby might be at rest. Victory cometh only by the help of Allah. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةًۭ مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلْأَقْدَامَ
verses.itani: He made drowsiness overcome you, as a security from Him. And He sent down upon you water from the sky, to cleanse you with it, and to rid you of Satan’s pollution, and to fortify your hearts, and to strengthen your foothold.
verses.pickthall: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُوحِى رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ سَأُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَٱضْرِبُوا۟ فَوْقَ ٱلْأَعْنَاقِ وَٱضْرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍۢ
verses.itani: Your Lord inspired the angels: “I am with you, so support those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike above the necks, and strike off every fingertip of theirs.”
verses.pickthall: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.itani: That is because they opposed God and His Messenger. Whoever opposes God and His Messenger—God is severe in retribution.
verses.pickthall: That is because they opposed Allah and His messenger. Whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, (for him) lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.itani: “Here it is; so taste it.” For the disbelievers there is the suffering of the Fire.
verses.pickthall: That (is the award), so taste it, and (know) that for disbelievers is the torment of the Fire.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًۭا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
verses.itani: O you who believe! When you meet those who disbelieve on the march, never turn your backs on them.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye meet those who disbelieve in battle, turn not your backs to them.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًۭا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍۢ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.itani: Anyone who turns his back on them on that Day, except while maneuvering for battle, or to join another group, has incurred wrath from God, and his abode is Hell—what a miserable destination!
verses.pickthall: Whoso on that day turneth his back to them, unless manoeuvring for battle or intent to join a company, he truly hath incurred wrath from Allah, and his habitation will be hell, a hapless journey's end.

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ ۚ وَلِيُبْلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: It was not you who killed them, but it was God who killed them. And it was not you who launched when you launched, but it was God who launched. That He may bestow upon the believers an excellent reward. God is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Ye (Muslims) slew them not, but Allah slew them. And thou (Muhammad) threwest not when thou didst throw, but Allah threw, that He might test the believers by a fair test from Him. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.itani: Such is the case. God will undermine the strategy of the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: That (is the case); and (know) that Allah (it is) Who maketh weak the plan of disbelievers.

verses.arabic: إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا۟ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْفَتْحُ ۖ وَإِن تَنتَهُوا۟ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تَعُودُوا۟ نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِىَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.itani: If you desire a verdict, the verdict has come to you. And if you desist, it would be best for you. And if you return, We will return; and your troops, however numerous, will not benefit you. God is with the believers.
verses.pickthall: (O Qureysh!) If ye sought a judgment, now hath the judgment come unto you. And if ye cease (from persecuting the believers) it will be better for you, but if ye return (to the attack) We also shall return. And your host will avail you naught, however numerous it be, and (know) that Allah is with the believers (in His Guidance).

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
verses.itani: O you who believe! Obey God and His Messenger, and do not turn away from him when you hear.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and His messenger, and turn not away from him when ye hear (him speak).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.itani: And be not like those who say, “We hear,” when they do not hear.
verses.pickthall: Be not as those who say, we hear, and they hear not.

verses.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلْبُكْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.itani: The worst of animals to God are the deaf and dumb—those who do not reason.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf, the dumb, who have no sense.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًۭا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.itani: Had God recognized any good in them, He would have made them hear; and had He made them hear, they would have turned away defiantly.
verses.pickthall: Had Allah known of any good in them He would have made them hear, but had He made them hear they would have turned away, averse.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.itani: O you who believe! Respond to God and to the Messenger when He calls you to what will revive you. And know that God stands between a man and his heart, and that to Him you will be gathered.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and the messenger when He calleth you to that which quickeneth you, and know that Allah cometh in between the man and his own heart, and that He it is unto Whom ye will be gathered.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةًۭ ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.itani: And beware of discord which does not afflict the wrongdoers among you exclusively; and know that God is severe in retribution.
verses.pickthall: And guard yourselves against a chastisement which cannot fall exclusively on those of you who are wrong-doers, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌۭ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.itani: And remember when you were few, oppressed in the land, fearing that people may capture you; but He sheltered you, and supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things—so that you may be thankful.
verses.pickthall: And remember, when ye were few and reckoned feeble in the land, and were in fear lest men should extirpate you, how He gave you refuge, and strengthened you with His help, and made provision of good things for you, that haply ye might be thankful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَخُونُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓا۟ أَمَٰنَٰتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.itani: O you who believe! Do not betray God and the Messenger, nor betray your trusts, while you know.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Betray not Allah and His messenger, nor knowingly betray your trusts.

verses.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that God possesses an immense reward.
verses.pickthall: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that with Allah is immense reward.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًۭا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.itani: O you who believe! If you remain conscious of God, He will give you a criterion, and will remit from you your sins, and will forgive you. God is possessor of infinite grace.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If ye keep your duty to Allah, He will give you discrimination (between right and wrong) and will rid you of your evil thoughts and deeds, and will forgive you. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ
verses.itani: When the disbelievers plotted against you, to imprison you, or kill you, or expel you. They planned, and God planned, but God is the Best of planners.
verses.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve plot against thee (O Muhammad) to wound thee fatally, or to kill thee or to drive thee forth; they plot, but Allah (also) plotteth; and Allah is the best of plotters.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالُوا۟ قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَٰذَآ ۙ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.itani: And when Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “We have heard. Had we wanted, we could have said the like of this; these are nothing but myths of the ancients.”
verses.pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto them they say: We have heard. If we wish we can speak the like of this. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
verses.itani: And they said, “Our God, if this is the truth from You, then rain down on us stones from the sky, or visit us with a painful affliction.”
verses.pickthall: And when they said: O Allah! If this be indeed the truth from Thee, then rain down stones on us or bring on us some painful doom!

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.itani: But God would not punish them while you are amongst them. And God would not punish them as long as they seek forgiveness.
verses.pickthall: But Allah would not punish them while thou wast with them, nor will He punish them while they seek forgiveness.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.itani: Yet why should God not punish them, when they are turning others away from the Sacred Mosque, although they are not its custodians? Its rightful custodians are the pious; but most of them do not know.
verses.pickthall: What (plea) have they that Allah should not punish them, when they debar (His servants) from the Inviolable Place of Worship, though they are not its fitting guardians. Its fitting guardians are those only who keep their duty to Allah. But most of them know not.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءًۭ وَتَصْدِيَةًۭ ۚ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.itani: Their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and clapping—so taste the punishment for your blasphemy.
verses.pickthall: And their worship at the (holy) House is naught but whistling and hand-clapping. Therefore (it is said unto them): Taste of the doom because ye disbelieve.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةًۭ ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
verses.itani: Those who disbelieve spend their wealth to repel from God’s path. They will spend it, then it will become a source of sorrow for them, and then they will be defeated. Those who disbelieve will be herded into Hell.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve spend their wealth in order that they may debar (men) from the way of Allah. They will spend it, then it will become an anguish for them, then they will be conquered. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto hell,

verses.arabic: لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُۥ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَيَرْكُمَهُۥ جَمِيعًۭا فَيَجْعَلَهُۥ فِى جَهَنَّمَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.itani: That God may distinguish the bad from the good, and heap the bad on top of one another, and pile them together, and throw them in Hell. These are the losers.
verses.pickthall: That Allah may separate the wicked from the good, The wicked will He place piece upon piece, and heap them all together, and consign them unto hell. Such verily are the losers.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَنتَهُوا۟ يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا۟ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.itani: Say to those who disbelieve: if they desist, their past will be forgiven. But if they persist—the practice of the ancients has passed away.
verses.pickthall: Tell those who disbelieve that if they cease (from persecution of believers) that which is past will be forgiven them; but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone (before them, for a warning).

verses.arabic: وَقَٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۚ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: Fight them until there is no more persecution, and religion becomes exclusively for God. But if they desist—God is Seeing of what they do.
verses.pickthall: And fight them until persecution is no more, and religion is all for Allah. But if they cease, then lo! Allah is Seer of what they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
verses.itani: And if they turn away, know that God is your Protector. The Best Protector, and the Best Supporter.
verses.pickthall: And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your Befriender - a Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper!

verses.arabic: ۞ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
verses.itani: And know that whatever spoils you gain, to God belongs its fifth, and to the Messenger, and the relatives, and the orphans, and the poor, and to the wayfarer, provided you believe in God and in what We revealed to Our servant on the Day of Distinction, the day when the two armies met. God is Capable of everything.
verses.pickthall: And know that whatever ye take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, if ye believe in Allah and that which We revealed unto Our slave on the Day of Discrimination, the day when the two armies met. And Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَنتُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْمِيعَٰدِ ۙ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًۭا كَانَ مَفْعُولًۭا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍۢ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍۢ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.itani: Recall when you were on the nearer bank, and they were on the further bank, and the caravan was below you. Had you planned for this meeting, you would have disagreed on the timing, but God was to carry out a predetermined matter, so that those who perish would perish by clear evidence, and those who survive would survive by clear evidence. God is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.pickthall: When ye were on the near bank (of the valley) and they were on the yonder bank, and the caravan was below you (on the coast plain). And had ye trysted to meet one another ye surely would have failed to keep the tryst, but (it happened, as it did, without the forethought of either of you) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done; that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty). Lo! Allah in truth is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَوْ أَرَىٰكَهُمْ كَثِيرًۭا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.itani: God made them appear in your dream as few. Had He made them appear as many, you would have lost heart, and disputed in the matter. But God saved the situation. He knows what the hearts contain.
verses.pickthall: When Allah showed them unto thee (O Muhammad) in thy dream as few in number, and if He had shown them to thee as many, ye (Muslims) would have faltered and would have quarrelled over the affair. But Allah saved (you). Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ ٱلْتَقَيْتُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًۭا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًۭا كَانَ مَفْعُولًۭا ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.itani: When you met, He made them appear as few in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes, so that God may conclude a predetermined matter. To God all matters revert.
verses.pickthall: And when He made you (Muslims), when ye met (them), see them with your eyes as few, and lessened you in their eyes, (it was) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done. Unto Allah all things are brought back.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةًۭ فَٱثْبُتُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.itani: O you who believe! When you meet a force, stand firm, and remember God much, so that you may prevail.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye meet an army, hold firm and think of Allah much, that ye may be successful.

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَنَٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ ۖ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.itani: And obey God and His Messenger, and do not dispute, lest you falter and lose your courage. And be steadfast. God is with the steadfast.
verses.pickthall: And obey Allah and His messenger, and dispute not one with another lest ye falter and your strength depart from you; but be steadfast! Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بَطَرًۭا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌۭ
verses.itani: And do not be like those who left their homes boastfully, showing off before the people, and barring others from the path of God. God comprehends what they do.
verses.pickthall: Be not as those who came forth from their dwellings boastfully and to be seen of men, and debar (men) from the way of Allah, while Allah is surrounding all they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّى جَارٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.itani: Satan made their deeds appear good to them, and said, “You cannot be defeated by any people today, and I am at your side.” But when the two armies came in sight of one another, he turned on his heels, and said, “I am innocent of you; I see what you do not see; I fear God; God is severe in punishment.”
verses.pickthall: And when Satan made their deeds seem fair to them and said: No-one of mankind can conquer you this day, for I am your protector. But when the armies came in sight of one another, he took flight, saying: Lo! I am guiltless of you. Lo! I see that which ye see not. Lo! I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: The hypocrites and those in whose hearts is sickness said, “Their religion has deluded these people.” But whoever puts his trust in God—God is Mighty and Wise.
verses.pickthall: When the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease said: Their religion hath deluded these. Whoso putteth his trust in Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۙ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.itani: If only you could see, as the angels take away those who disbelieve, striking their faces and their backs: “Taste the agony of the Burning.”
verses.pickthall: If thou couldst see how the angels receive those who disbelieve, smiting faces and their backs and (saying): Taste the punishment of burning!

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.itani: “That is because of what your hands have committed, and because God is not unjust to the servants.”
verses.pickthall: This is for that which your own hands have sent before (to the Judgment), and (know) that Allah is not a tyrant to His slaves.

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّۭ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.itani: Like the behavior of the people of Pharaoh, and those before them. They rejected the signs of God, so God seized them for their sins. God is Powerful, Severe in punishment.
verses.pickthall: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they disbelieved the revelations of Allah, and Allah took them in their sins. Lo! Allah is Strong, severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًۭا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: That is because God would never change a blessing He has bestowed on a people unless they change what is within themselves, and because God is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah never changeth the grace He hath bestowed on any people until they first change that which is in their hearts, and (that is) because Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.itani: Such was the case with the people of Pharaoh, and those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We annihilated them for their wrongs, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh—they were all evildoers.
verses.pickthall: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they denied the revelations of their Lord, so We destroyed them in their sins. And We drowned the folk of Pharaoh. All were evil-doers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.itani: The worst of creatures in God's view are those who disbelieve. They have no faith.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the ungrateful who will not believe.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِى كُلِّ مَرَّةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.itani: Those of them with whom you made a treaty, but they violate their agreement every time. They are not righteous.
verses.pickthall: Those of them with whom thou madest a treaty, and then at every opportunity they break their treaty, and they keep not duty (to Allah).

verses.arabic: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.itani: If you confront them in battle, make of them a fearsome example for those who follow them, that they may take heed.
verses.pickthall: If thou comest on them in the war, deal with them so as to strike fear in those who are behind them, that haply they may remember.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةًۭ فَٱنۢبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
verses.itani: If you fear treachery on the part of a people, break off with them in a like manner. God does not like the treacherous.
verses.pickthall: And if thou fearest treachery from any folk, then throw back to them (their treaty) fairly. Lo! Allah loveth not the treacherous.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَبَقُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
verses.itani: Let not the disbelievers assume that they are ahead. They will not escape.
verses.pickthall: And let not those who disbelieve suppose that they can outstrip (Allah's Purpose). Lo! they cannot escape.

verses.arabic: وَأَعِدُّوا۟ لَهُم مَّا ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍۢ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِۦ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
verses.itani: And prepare against them all the power you can muster, and all the cavalry you can mobilize, to terrify thereby God’s enemies and your enemies, and others besides them whom you do not know, but God knows them. Whatever you spend in God’s way will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: Make ready for them all thou canst of (armed) force and of horses tethered, that thereby ye may dismay the enemy of Allah and your enemy, and others beside them whom ye know not. Allah knoweth them. Whatsoever ye spend in the way of Allah it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.

verses.arabic: ۞ وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.itani: But if they incline towards peace, then incline towards it, and put your trust in God. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
verses.pickthall: And if they incline to peace, incline thou also to it, and trust in Allah. Lo! He, even He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَبِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.itani: If they intend to deceive you—God is sufficient for you. It is He who supported you with His aid, and with the believers.
verses.pickthall: And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers,

verses.arabic: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مَّآ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: And He united their hearts. Had you spent everything on earth, you would not have united their hearts, but God united them together. He is Mighty and Wise.
verses.pickthall: And (as for the believers) hath attuned their hearts. If thou hadst spent all that is in the earth thou couldst not have attuned their hearts, but Allah hath attuned them. Lo! He is Mighty, Wise.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.itani: O prophet! Count on God, and on the believers who have followed you.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Allah is Sufficient for thee and those who follow thee of the believers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ ۚ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌۭ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.itani: O prophet! Rouse the believers to battle. If there are twenty steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a hundred of you, they will defeat a thousand of those who disbelieve; because they are a people who do not understand.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Exhort the believers to fight. If there be of you twenty steadfast they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a hundred (steadfast) they shall overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they (the disbelievers) are a folk without intelligence.

verses.arabic: ٱلْـَٰٔنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًۭا ۚ فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌۭ صَابِرَةٌۭ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌۭ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.itani: God has now lightened your burden, knowing that there is weakness in you. If there are a hundred steadfast among you, they will defeat two hundred; and if there are a thousand of you, they will defeat two thousand by God’s leave. God is with the steadfast.
verses.pickthall: Now hath Allah lightened your burden, for He knoweth that there is weakness in you. So if there be of you a steadfast hundred they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a thousand (steadfast) they shall overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. Allah is with the steadfast.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: It is not for a prophet to take prisoners before he has subdued the land. You desire the materials of this world, but God desires the Hereafter. God is Strong and Wise.
verses.pickthall: It is not for any prophet to have captives until he hath made slaughter in the land. Ye desire the lure of this world and Allah desireth (for you) the Hereafter, and Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَا كِتَٰبٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَآ أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: Were it not for a predetermined decree from God, an awful punishment would have afflicted you for what you have taken.
verses.pickthall: Had it not been for an ordinance of Allah which had gone before, an awful doom had come upon you on account of what ye took.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَٰلًۭا طَيِّبًۭا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: So consume what you have gained, legitimate and wholesome; and remain conscious of God. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.pickthall: Now enjoy what ye have won, as lawful and good, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَن فِىٓ أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَسْرَىٰٓ إِن يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًۭا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًۭا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: O prophet! Say to those you hold prisoners, “If God finds any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Say unto those captives who are in your hands: If Allah knoweth any good in your hearts He will give you better than that which hath been taken from you, and will forgive you. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا۟ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.itani: But if they intend to betray you, they have already betrayed God, and He has overpowered them. God is Knowing and Wise.
verses.pickthall: And if they would betray thee, they betrayed Allah before, and He gave (thee) power over them. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنِ ٱسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled in God’s cause with their possessions and their persons, and those who provided shelter and support—these are allies of one another. As for those who believed, but did not emigrate, you owe them no protection, until they have emigrated. But if they ask you for help in religion, you must come to their aid, except against a people with whom you have a treaty. God is Seeing of what you do.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believed and left their homes and strove with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them: these are protecting friends one of another. And those who believed but did not leave their homes, ye have no duty to protect them till they leave their homes; but if they seek help from you in the matter of religion then it is your duty to help (them) except against a folk between whom and you there is a treaty. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: As for those who disbelieve, they are allies of one another. Unless you do this, there will be turmoil in the land, and much corruption.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve are protectors one of another - If ye do not so, there will be confusion in the land, and great corruption.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّۭا ۚ لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verses.itani: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled for God’s cause, and those who gave shelter and support—these are the true believers. They will have forgiveness, and a bountiful provision.
verses.pickthall: Those who believed and left their homes and strove for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them - these are the believers in truth. For them is pardon, and bountiful provision.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍۢ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
verses.itani: As for those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and struggled with you—these belong with you. But family members are nearer to one another in the Book of God. God is Cognizant of everything.
verses.pickthall: And those who afterwards believed and left their homes and strove along with you, they are of you; and those who are akin are nearer one to another in the ordinance of Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.
